items.text:
Hello! We are having multiple claims denying for incorrect procedure code being billed.  Our patients are being transferred from an acute inpatient hospital to a rehab facility that is in the same building.  We are billing an admission to the inpatient rehab facility.  Should we be billing a subsequent visit instead? Are they being considered the same admission? 

We also have claims denying if a patient is seen by our physiatrist and our internal medicine physician on the same day for different diagnoses.  We have appealed with medical records and have stated two different specialties but our claims are still being upheld.  Any help or insight would be appreciated.  Thank you!
